name: test-coverage-review-py
description: Use before merging a change to the Python (FastAPI) backend, or when asked "does this PR have adequate tests?". Read-only reviewer that judges whether a diff carries meaningful, behavior-asserting pytest coverage against this repo's model (flat tests/ dir + conftest, Protocol-mockable repositories, mandatory ops-behavior tests, --cov-fail-under=90). Reports a PASS / CHANGES-REQUESTED verdict with concrete gaps; never edits, stages, or runs the app.
